narrative.overview: Warm surfaces, compact typography, continuous working areas and restrained elevation. This source-derived record covers shared chrome, the paginated editor explorer, registry presentation, the bounded endpoint workspace, response authoring, selection and primary-response faults. Editor / Callback / Settings, responsive request/response panes, the continuous Body canvas, saved-weight chances, scoped Sequence runtime, direct Rule controls and draft fault summaries are delivered. The bounded S06/S07/S08/S09 milestone brings the checklist to 24/72; History/basic pool safeguards (S02/S10) and Callback remain pending.
keyCharacteristics: System UI and local mono typography
Existing feature and mutation contracts retained

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Change light and dark mappings together, using existing semantic CSS roles.

rules.name: The Continuous Surface Rule
rules.body: Registry rows touch and share borders; workbench cards/buttons do not gain decorative elevation or hover translation.

dos: Do retain full endpoint identities and accessible names.
Do keep unchecked migrations visibly future work.
Do keep the visible footer Shortcuts opener available after single-key opt-out.
donts: Don't treat the delivered endpoint workspace, response authoring and bounded S06/S07/S08/S09 milestone as completion of History/basic pool safeguards (S02/S10), Callback or the full upgrade checklist.
Do not store configuration drafts or secrets in workbench preferences.
Do not alter matching, import, mutation or run-isolation behavior as a visual side effect.
